SELECT p.clubJoin_num, p.clubOwner_key, p.position, p.uniform_no, TO_CHAR(p.join_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS join_date, p.status, m.userName, m.memberIdx FROM Player p JOIN clubJoin cj ON p.clubJoin_num = cj.clubJoin_num JOIN member1 m ON cj.memberIdx = m.memberIdx WHERE p.clubOwner_key = #{clubOwner_key} AND p.status = '1'
AND m.userName LIKE '%' || #{userName} || '%'
AND p.position = #{position}
ORDER BY p.join_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE Player SET status = '0', leave_date = SYSDATE WHERE clubJoin_num = #{clubJoin_num}
